asset.title: Manage CleanShot access centrally
asset.content:
Subject: Manage CleanShot access centrally
Preview text: Review SSO, SCIM and annual per-user pricing for your Mac team.

Bring CleanShot under central access management

Hi there,

Set up centrally managed CleanShot access for a compatible Mac team with SSO, SCIM and admin controls in CleanShot Cloud.

CleanShot Pro pairs those access features with CleanShot’s screenshot and screen-recording app for Mac, giving IT one team configuration to review.

The Pro plan is $10 per user per month, billed annually. Each seat requires macOS 13.0 or newer.

The pricing page shows the Pro offer and annual per-user terms, including centralized access management, SSO and SCIM. Use it to decide whether CleanShot Pro fits your intended Mac team.

Review CleanShot Pro → https://cleanshot.com/pricing

- CleanShot

decision.summary: Every material factual assertion is supported by the supplied literal sources. The draft retains annual billing and macOS eligibility conditions and makes none of the prohibited compatibility, free-trial, replacement, savings or guaranteed-outcome claims.

asset_metadata.single_idea: For a compatible Mac team, CleanShot Pro combines the screenshot and screen-recording app with centralized access management, SSO, SCIM and admin controls at $10 per user per month billed annually.

selected_brief.selection_reason: SSO, SCIM and admin controls give this reader a concrete team-access reason to consider CleanShot Pro. The annual per-seat price and macOS requirement provide the terms needed to judge whether an evaluation is relevant.

value_case.reader_benefit: If the intended users have compatible Macs, IT can consider one CleanShot Pro team configuration with centralized access management instead of evaluating the app only as an individual capture tool.
value_case.mechanism: CleanShot Pro includes centralized access management, SSO and SCIM; CleanShot Cloud also provides admin controls for managing team access.
decision_conditions: CleanShot Pro is $10 per user per month when billed annually.
Each intended seat requires macOS 13.0 or newer.

claim_conditions: $10 per user per month, billed annually
macOS 13.0 or newer on each intended seat
Pro tier, billed annually, per user per month (E18)
Admin configures SSO, SCIM and admin controls in CleanShot Cloud (E24)
macOS 13.0 or newer on every seat (E12)
No vendor free trial; evaluation rests on the 30-day money-back guarantee requested from support, and the 7-day trial is a third-party Setapp offer (E13)
Do not promise: No claim that rollout is zero-disruption or requires no change to current tooling
Do not promise: No claim of headcount or time savings
Do not promise: No claim that CleanShot replaces or outperforms an incumbent tool
Do not promise: No claim of readiness for future team growth beyond the quoted 'as your team grows' wording
Do not promise: No claim of compatibility with any named identity provider, directory or MDM such as Jamf
Do not promise: No claim of coverage for non-Mac employees
Not established: Compatibility with the company's specific existing identity provider or directory
Not established: Documented de-provisioning behaviour when a user is removed upstream
This is a documented-use draft, not proof of the broader audience hypothesis or recipient fit.
selected_brief.target_audience: IT admin or team lead rolling out CleanShot to a team
selected_brief.job: Get the reader to review the Pro offer and decide whether its centralized access features and annual per-seat terms justify evaluating it for a compatible Mac team.
selected_brief.single_idea: For a compatible Mac team, CleanShot Pro combines the screenshot and screen-recording app with centralized access management, SSO, SCIM and admin controls at $10 per user per month billed annually.
selected_brief.mechanism: CleanShot Pro includes centralized access management, SSO and SCIM, while CleanShot Cloud supplies the associated admin controls for team access.
selected_brief.belief_shift: Before: CleanShot may appear to be only an individual Mac capture app. After: the reader sees that its Pro tier also offers SSO, SCIM and admin controls for centrally managed team access, subject to annual per-seat pricing and Mac eligibility.
must_not_say: Do not claim that rollout is zero-disruption or requires no change to current tooling.
Do not claim headcount savings, time savings or guaranteed operational results.
Do not claim that CleanShot replaces or outperforms an incumbent tool.
Do not promise readiness for future team growth beyond the documented functions.
Do not claim compatibility with any named identity provider, directory or MDM, including Jamf.
Do not claim coverage for Windows or non-Mac employees.
Do not claim compatibility with the recipient's existing identity provider or directory.
Do not describe upstream user removal or de-provisioning behavior; it is not established.
Do not imply that CleanShot offers a direct free trial.
Do not assert that the recipient currently uses scattered personal licenses or has already begun a rollout.
Do not turn unknown rollout or access-management circumstances into an established buyer pain.
Do not add unrelated capture, recording, storage, branding or sharing features to this team-access argument.
selected_brief.objection: Will the intended seats be eligible? CleanShot requires macOS 13.0 or newer; compatibility with the reader’s particular identity provider, directory or MDM remains unconfirmed.
selected_brief.tone: Friendly, direct and reassuring, with restrained confidence and no hard-sell pressure.
selected_brief.call_to_action: Get CleanShot for Mac and review the Pro offer.
selected_brief.next_step_decision: Decide whether CleanShot Pro’s centralized access features, annual per-seat price and Mac requirement make it relevant for the intended team.
selected_brief.next_step_value: The pricing page shows that Pro costs $10 per user per month billed annually and includes centralized access management, SSO and SCIM.
selected_brief.next_step_limit: Reviewing the offer does not establish compatibility with the reader’s identity provider, directory or MDM, nor does it prove deployment or de-provisioning behavior.
selected_brief.subject_strategy: Signal that CleanShot has a team-management proposition for Mac IT buyers; foreground centralized access rather than using a generic screenshot-app introduction or implying an existing rollout problem.
